title: Sharp condition-number bounds for growth factors of Higham matrices in Gaussian elimination
summary: Higham's conjecture on the growth factor of complex symmetric positive definite matrices is a longstanding problem in the stability theory of Gaussian elimination without pivoting. It asserts that every complex matrix $A=B+iC$ with $B$ and $C$ real symmetric positive definite, is called Higham matrix and has growth factor $ρ_n(A)<2$. In 2013, Drury [Linear Algebra Appl. \textbf{439} (2013), no.~10, 3129--3133] proved that $ρ_n(A)\le 2$.
